Elegantly designed for enchanting coastal experiences, this beachside oasis features a private pool, sitting spa, sprawling outdoor space, as well as a private boardwalk to the sugar-soft beach.Adorned with aesthetic cypress and marble elements, the Main House’s first-level great room enraptures guests from the moment of entry. The gourmet kitchen features premium appliances and a 4-seat breakfast bar for elevated cooking and entertaining. Relax in the elegant living space or savor a meal at the concrete dining table, which features 2 long benches and 2 chairs. Expansive 10-foot sliding doors frame unobstructed Gulf views, inviting guests to step into the backyard, where a Gulf-front pool, sitting spa, and beach boardwalk evoke the sense of a private villa. Unwind in the swinging hammock beneath flourishing palm trees or sunbathe on plush loungers. The primary bedroom’s soft king bed and private bathroom promise a peaceful nightly haven.The second level centers around a spacious entryway and a wet bar. Choose between 2 beautifully appointed guest bedrooms with a king bed, 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed, 1 guest bedroom with 2 full beds, or the kid-friendly bunk area with 1 twin-over-twin bunk. The 2 king bedrooms include a Gulf-facing terrace with comfortable seating.On the top level, a vaulted ceiling stretches over another light-filled great room, complete with a chef’s kitchen, 4-seat dining table, and a luxe living area. Open the glass doors to enjoy the sweet Gulf breeze, or step outside to toast the kaleidoscope sunset. The guest bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom.Connected by the second-level breezeway, the airy Carriage House includes a full kitchen, cozy living space, booth-style dining area, and a private balcony. The 2 guest bedrooms feature king beds and private bathrooms.Direct beach access and a spectacular outdoor space—plus on-site parking and 8 complimentary adult bikes—make 3036 East County Highway 30A perfect for an indulgent Seagrove Beach getaway. body_text_excerpt: Destination Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Seagrove Beach 3036 East County Highway 30A Santa Rosa Beach, Florida Bedrooms 7 Beds 10 Sleeps 20 Full Baths 7 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Private Pool - 8 adult bikes - Grill - Low speed vehicle - Complimentary beach service 1 set (2 chairs 1 umbrella) is provided March 1- October 31 - Complimentary Peloton Bike- an Alaya exclusive amenity - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Perched along the dazzling Gulf shore, 3036 East County Highway 30A promises a decadent Seagrove Beach escape with 8 lavish bedrooms and 8.5 bathrooms between the 3-level Main House and Carriage House, comfortably accommodating 22 guests. Elegantly designed for enchanting coastal experiences, this beachside oasis features a private pool, sitting spa, sprawling outdoor space, as well as a private boardwalk to the sugar-soft beach. Adorned with aesthetic cypress and marble elements, the Main House’s first-level great room enraptures guests from the moment of entry. The gourmet kitchen features premium appliances and a 4-seat breakfast bar for elevated cooking and entertaining. Relax in the elegant living space or savor a meal at the concrete dining table, which features 2 long benches and 2 chairs. Expansive 10-foot sliding doors frame unobstructed Gulf views, inviting guests to step into the backyard, where a Gulf-front pool, sitting spa, and beach boardwalk evoke the sense of a private villa. Unwind in the swinging hammock beneath flourishing palm trees or sunbathe on plush loungers. The primary bedroom’s soft king bed and private bathroom promise a peaceful nightly haven. The second level centers around a spacious entryway and a wet bar. Choose between 2 beautifully appointed guest bedrooms with a king bed, 1 guest bedroom with a queen bed, 1 guest bedroom with 2 full beds, or the kid-friendly bunk area with 1 twin-over-twin bunk. The 2 king bedrooms include a Gulf-facing terrace with comfortable seating. On the top level, a vaulted ceiling stretches over another light-filled great room, complete with a chef’s kitchen, 4-seat dining table, and a luxe living area. Open the glass doors to enjoy the sweet Gulf breeze, or step outside to toast the kaleidoscope sunset. The guest bedroom features a king bed and a private bathroom. Connected by the second-level breezeway, the airy Carriage House includes a full kitchen, cozy living space, booth-style dining area, and a private balcony. The 2 guest bedrooms feature king beds and private bathrooms. Direct beach access and a spectacular outdoor space—plus on-site parking and 8 complimentary adult bikes—make 3036 East County Highway 30A perfect for an indulgent Seagrove Beach getaway. Book today and discover the best of 30A!
